rows.notes: Sichuan New Energy Power (川能动力) FY2025 AR (000155_2025.txt): design capacity 1.05 Mt/yr ore and 180 kt/yr lithium concentrate (lines 568-569), formal full-load operation of mining/beneficiation/tailings from Sept 2025 (matches Yahua AR). 2025 output: ore 1.0011 Mt (sales 142,900 t of ore sold as such), lithium concentrate 126,800 t produced (self-produced plus toll-processed, per table lines 1091-1095) and 144,600 t sold (inventory fell from 33,600 t); i.e. 70% of the 180 kt nameplate in the first (ramp-up) year. production_norm left null: concentrate grade not stated. Ownership: 川能动力 holds 62.75% of Nengtou Lithium (能投锂业, lines 168-170), which holds 75% of Dexin Mining (德鑫矿业, lines 174-176); the AR text does not itself say that Dexin is the Lijiagou licence holder - the licence is described as the company's ('公司拥有 ... 李家沟锂辉石矿开采权', line 565) - so the Dexin link rests on the earlier SC003 row. The 37.25% Yahua stake in Nengtou is consistent with 100% - 62.75%. Effective 川能动力 look-through to Lijiagou would be about 47% if Dexin is the holder (62.75% x 75%), not stated in the filing. Company totals: lithium concentrate 126,800 t produced / 144,600 t sold; lithium salt design capacity 45,000 t/yr, output 9,700 t, sales 11,200 t (lines 574-575). The Lijiagou North exploration right is held by the controlling shareholder (Sichuan Energy Development Group, lines 923-924), exploration stage, no row.

Sichuan New Energy Power FY2025 AR: Deah Lithium's new 30 kt/yr lithium salt project - carbonate line in trial production, qualified battery-grade product 2025-07-31, carbonate line reached design output ('达标达产') on 2025-10-26 (lines 576-577); 川能动力 holds 51% (line 2113), registered capital RMB 750m. The AR does NOT say the hydroxide line was commissioned: construction-in-progress for the '德阿产业园年产3万吨锂盐项目' fell from RMB 980.1m to RMB 180.9m (lines 10615-10617), only the carbonate line was pre-transferred to fixed assets in Oct 2025 (line 1638-1644), so part of the plant (likely the hydroxide line) was still in construction at 2025-12-31; capacity row unchanged (30,000 t salt = 15,000 carbonate + 15,000 hydroxide per SC007; not restated in AR). Plant output is not given separately: company-wide lithium salt output 9,700 t / sales 11,200 t in 2025 (Dingsheng + Deah, incl. toll processing; line 575), design capacity 45,000 t/yr. CONFLICT with SC007 third-party summary (川能动力 stakes '能投锂业 58%/鼎盛锂业 72%/德阿 51%'): the AR gives 62.75% / 51% / 51% - AR figures preferred, only Deah 51% matches.

An application for a 5 Mt/yr permit is in process (prerequisites done; undated, so not counted as capacity) and the 5,000 t/day concentrator expansion entered trial production (lines 522-526). Concentrate output is not disclosed. Jinxin 2025 revenue RMB 598.9m, net profit RMB 38.8m (lines 11745-11757). OWNERSHIP FLAG: the AR calls Jinxin an associate ('参股子公司') in which Guocheng holds only 48% via Beijing Hurong (lines 107, 11714, 12128) - the row's earlier parent_company 'Guocheng Mining' overstates control; the controlling holder is not named in the filing (history: Fujian Zhonghe bankruptcy restructuring, Guocheng Changqing and Guangzhou Guocheng Deyuan capital increase, lines 12688-12747). Operator kept as Jinxin Mining; status 'operational' now rests on the 2025 ore output (replaces reported-tier status). start_year 2024 retained from SC003 (licence 2024-01 per Mysteel) - not re-confirmed here.

Guocheng Mining FY2025 AR (000688_2025.txt): Guocheng Lithium (控股子公司) is in the Deyang-Aba eco-industrial park, Mianzhu, planning 200 kt/yr lithium salt with Phase 1 of 60 kt/yr 'basic lithium salt' (lines 529-530; no carbonate/hydroxide split, matches Xinhua figure in the row). At 2025-12-31 the project was still under construction: construction-in-progress RMB 836.8m, budget RMB 1,782.4m (178,236.68 万元), progress 46.95% (lines 9699-9721; 2025 additions RMB 819.9m); civil works for acidification, purification, sodium sulphate and carbonate sections and utilities at roof level (lines 531-534). This is consistent with the Xinhua report in the row that Phase 1 began production on 2026-07-12; the AR (published 2026-03-24) therefore does not conflict with 'operational'. Guocheng's stake percentage in Guocheng Lithium is not stated in the AR (description: 控股子公司; tax table line 8728 only).

The LCE equivalence is the company's industry-experience conversion, ore tonnage is not stated, so production is in t LCE-equivalent of ore, not of chemical.
